  • Today 6PM
  • Today 8PM

Sambad lottery is also popular in the west bengal and Kolkata. You can check Lottery Sambad Old result chart.

Draw Result

Today all of the result has been updated here on this page. All result has been updated here on this one single page for the day November 5 2026. All of you may check  result online. Yes its 100% real. Nagaland state lottery owned and regulate by the Nagaland and established in 1972. It run, regulated, supervised and financed by the Nagaland state.
